title: Wharf, Main Island

relevant_locator: Main island wharf point layer; MARKID, MARKTYPE1, MARKNAME1, UPD_YYYYMM, EPSG:3826
temporal_proof: The live resource was retrieved after the bookmark. Admission is record scoped: the seven selected port records each carry an UPD_YYYYMM no later than 2022-12, and the ingestion firewall rejects any record updated after 2025-08.
reliability_notes: Authoritative geometry publisher. The postbookmark live snapshot is not treated as a contemporaneous opening artifact. Only stable, individually dated records are admitted, and the raw snapshot is frozen by SHA256.
